title: Add CLI to scaffold new backlog templates
summary: Manual editing works, but backlog templates are still easy to get wrong. Add a small CLI that appends a minimal, validator-friendly template skeleton (with safe defaults) and forces the author to fill in the parts that matter before seeding.
expectedFailureModes: Backlog templates are added with missing required fields or invalid enum values, forcing repeated fixups.
Template IDs collide with existing task files, causing `autonomy-seed-next` to remain exhausted.
Verification commands drift into machine-local paths or secrets because there is no scaffold guidance.
nextAction: Create a script that appends a new backlog template skeleton with a validated `id`, default `state=proposed`, safe empty lists, and a reminder checklist, then update docs to point to it.
